propositions: Coverage, complexity, and clone count metrics computed at CI run time need a durable append-only store to persist point-in-time snapshots for trend analysis.
Snapshot store must live under .rebar/ (git-tracked) not reports/ (gitignored) so the series accumulates across runs and syncs with the repository.
.gitignore must negatively-assert !.rebar/metrics-snapshots.ndjson to override the blanket .rebar/* ignore rule and allow the snapshot file to be committed.
write_snapshot() appends timestamped JSON records to the NDJSON store; read_snapshots(since,until) yields records within the date range; malformed lines are skipped without error.
Unit tests verify round-trip write/read, date range filtering, corruption tolerance, and that the snapshot file is not matched by repo .gitignore.
